decisions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

❌ ④ insufficient는 sufficient의 반의어

(A) It takes years of practice to truly <u>master</u> a musical instrument. Many people start learning as children, but only the most dedicated continue to improve throughout their lives.
(B) The <u>master</u> bedroom on the second floor has a private bathroom and a walk-in closet. It was recently renovated with new hardwood floors.
